verdict.rationale: CrewAI's official CLI documents a create command that scaffolds a new crew, flow, tool, skill, or template project (crewai-docs-25, crewai-docs-8, crewai-probe-4), and the CLI installs with a single `uv tool install crewai` (crewai-docs-15). The docs also offer a ready-to-paste setup prompt for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or other coding agents that installs the official CrewAI skills and checks the CLI (crewai-docs-58), which fits the coding-agent-driven scaffolding in this story. missing for 10: the exact one-command scaffold syntax and the generated project structure are not shown in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent running the scaffold.
